description_for_human: Multi-channel marketing automation: email campaigns, SMS, chatbots (WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook, Instagram, Viber, TikTok, LiveChat), CRM, automation flows, web push, and pop-ups.
description_for_model: SendPulse API for managing multi-channel marketing automation. Capabilities: email campaigns and mailing lists, transactional SMTP, SMS messaging, chatbots for WhatsApp/Telegram/Facebook/Instagram/Viber/TikTok/LiveChat, CRM with pipelines and deals, Automation 360 event-driven flows, web push notifications, pop-ups, email verifier, and file manager. Authentication: OAuth2 client_credentials flow via /oauth/access_token (token TTL 3600s) or static API key. All endpoints are under https://api.sendpulse.com. Full OpenAPI specs available at https://api.sendpulse.com/.well-known/openapi/index.yaml
